The upstream blob writes <DropdownMenu><DropdownMenu.Trigger>{children}</DropdownMenu.Trigger></DropdownMenu> without supplying controlled expanded state. Codex confirmed: (a) DropdownMenu.Trigger is an anchor/rendering container only — not an event wrapper (package/src/jetpack-compose/DropdownMenu/index.tsx:77-79); (b) DropdownMenuProps.expanded defaults to false (DropdownMenuRecords.kt:8-18); (c) no activationMethod field exposed on the TS surface in 55.0.6.
